studies.Reference: Impact of heavy metals, oxidative stress, expression of VHL, and antioxidant genes in the pathogenesis of renal cell carcinoma.
studies.Title: Impact of heavy metals, oxidative stress, expression of VHL, and antioxidant genes in the pathogenesis of renal cell carcinoma.
studies.Authors: Arulraj K, Quadri JA, Nayak B, Pandit S, Panayadiyan S, Singh P, Sarwar S, A S, Seth A
studies.Population: Renal cell carcinoma patients at a tertiary care centre and age-matched healthy volunteers
studies.comparison_type: Blood copper levels in RCC cases versus age-matched healthy controls

sample_size.excerpt: 150 cases and 150 age matched controls were enrolled.
sample_size.location: abstract, results; total_n derived from reported group counts 150 + 150 = 300

cases.excerpt: 150 cases and 150 age matched controls were enrolled.

p_value.excerpt: RCC cases had elevated blood levels of arsenic (P = 0.02), copper (P = 0.01)

comparison.excerpt: RCC cases had elevated blood levels of arsenic (P = 0.02), copper (P = 0.01), manganese (P < 0.001), cadmium (P < 0.001), lead (P < 0.001), and mercury (P = 0.02) compared to controls.

design.excerpt: This observational study recruited RCC patients who visited our tertiary care centre from 2019 to 2023. Age matched healthy volunteers were included as controls.

timing.excerpt: recruited RCC patients who visited our tertiary care centre from 2019 to 2023

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Levels of arsenic, copper, manganese, selenium, cadmium, lead, and mercury were measured in each of the samples.
